skill.name: xhs-viral-note-research
skill.description: 当用户给出小红书关键词、赛道、人群或产品方向，想看热门高互动笔记样本，并拆解标题结构、内容角度、互动信号、创作灵感和选题参考时使用。
skill.summary: Find high-engagement Xiaohongshu notes and use the retrieved samples to identify title patterns, content angles, and topic ideas.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most alerts match Markdown formatting, documentation links, or readable Chinese text. The skill directs agents and users to run an unpinned npm package that handles a vendor API key. The guide omits shell argument safeguards and directs agents to retain access-related URL tokens when storing or forwarding reports.

remediation.issue: On-demand execution of an unpinned npm package
remediation.suggestion: Use a reviewed, integrity-verified version and require explicit approval before fetching or running it. Prefer an already configured, trusted MCP connection when available.

remediation.issue: The external CLI reads or stores a vendor API key
remediation.suggestion: Use scoped keys and an OS credential store or managed secret injection. Verify restricted access and make the active credential source visible without revealing the key.

remediation.issue: Shell example does not define a safe argument boundary
remediation.suggestion: Use a structured tool or process API with a fixed argument list and no shell evaluation. Pass keywords and returned cursors as data.

remediation.issue: Unconditional retention of token-bearing note links
remediation.suggestion: Retain full links only in authorized private workflows. Use note IDs in shared reports and omit token values from logs, exports, and forwards by default.

remediation.issue: A billing error can supply the link shown to the user
remediation.suggestion: Use the documented billing URL rather than forwarding a response-supplied link. Never initiate payment automatically.

content.value_statement: It is hard to compare Xiaohongshu posts when search results mix formats and engagement levels. This skill gathers a focused sample and identifies title patterns, content angles, and ideas for future posts.
actual_capabilities: Searches public Xiaohongshu notes by keyword through the SocialDataX CLI or an authenticated MCP connection.
Sorts results by likes, comments, saves, or recency and filters by note type and publication range.
Supports cursor-based pagination, with page and sample limits available in the CLI.
Lists returned titles, authors, engagement counts, dates, links, and note IDs, and marks fields that are missing.
Summarizes title hooks, content angles, and engagement signals and suggests topics based on the samples.
limitations: Live search requires SocialDataX access. The CLI needs Node.js and an API key, while hosted MCP needs an authenticated connection.
Search requests may consume credits, and results cover only the pages returned for the chosen query and filters.
Engagement counts describe the sample. They do not establish what caused performance or predict future reach.
The skill does not write finished posts, design covers, diagnose accounts, publish, or interact with notes.

use_cases.title: Find angles for a new post
use_cases.description: Review popular notes on one topic and identify title structures and angles to test in an original post.

use_cases.title: Compare formats for a campaign brief
use_cases.description: Compare recent image and video samples, then use observed engagement differences to propose formats for a brief.

use_cases.title: Document engagement patterns
use_cases.description: Compare notes ranked by comments and saves and record the query, sample limits, and missing fields.

prompt_templates.title: Explore one topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Xiaohongshu for small apartment storage and review up to five notes from one page. Summarize two recurring title patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Compare image posts
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Filter by format and time.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find image notes about beginner home workouts published this week. Sort by likes and distinguish reported engagement counts from your interpretation.

prompt_templates.title: Compare saves and comments
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for desk organization twice, sorting by saves and then by comments. Limit each search to two pages and compare the topics in each sample.

prompt_templates.title: Build a bounded research brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Compare formats under a fixed sample limit.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare image and video notes about weekend meal prep from the past week. Sort both searches by likes and cap each at two pages and ten notes. Report missing fields and propose three original topics.

output_examples.input: Show an example one-page report for small apartment storage.
output: Illustrative sample: Two image notes show before-and-after changes. One note has 140 likes and 62 saves.
Title pattern: Name a specific space and state the improvement.
Topic idea: Compare two ways to organize a narrow entryway.

output_examples.input: Show how to summarize separate samples sorted by saves and comments.
output: Illustrative comparison: The save-ranked sample includes checklists, while the comment-ranked sample includes more questions about product choices.
Limitation: Only one page was available for each search, and one note had no visible publication date.
Next step: Test a checklist and a question-led post separately.

best_practices: Use a focused keyword and a small page limit for the first search.
Record the filters and sample size so readers can assess the scope of each comparison.
Keep secret keys out of prompts and verify that recipients are authorized before sharing token-bearing links.
anti_patterns: Treating the retrieved notes as a ranking of every post on the platform.
Using likes or saves as proof that a title or format caused higher engagement.
Restarting a paid search when partial results can be resumed within the original limits.

faq.question: What input do I need?
faq.answer: Provide a keyword or a topic. You can add an audience, format, or publication range to narrow the sample.

faq.question: Do I need an API key?
faq.answer: The CLI needs a SocialDataX API key. An authenticated hosted MCP connection can use its existing credentials.

faq.question: Does a search consume credits?
faq.answer: Search requests may consume SocialDataX credits. The documented CLI credential status check does not call a paid search endpoint.

faq.question: How many notes does the default CLI search request?
faq.answer: The documented example requests up to two pages and 20 notes. The service can return fewer.

faq.question: What happens when a search returns partial results?
faq.answer: The report marks the output as incomplete. If a continuation cursor is available, the search can resume within the original limits.

faq.question: Can the skill publish or change my account?
faq.answer: No. It searches and analyzes public notes without publishing, liking, commenting, or modifying an account.
